Unidentified systematic error or feedback in the resonator_obs channel (anomalous outlier)

Instrumental or calibration drift specific to pendulum measurement pathway: systematic error introduced or exposed around day 12 in one or both pendulum instruments

Negative autocorrelation at 7–8 day lag is real physical oscillation (e.g., weekly environmental cycle), not artifact; it predates and is independent of the day-12 shift
Statistical artifact: multiple-comparison bias in offset/lag search; weak cross-correlations and negative autocorrelations are consistent with random noise, not real patterns
Real physical change in pendulum system only, around day 12 (e.g., temperature rise, support stiffness change, damping shift); resonator unaffected.
Instrumental or calibration step-change specific to pendulum measurement pathway(s), triggered around day 12 (e.g., warm-up hysteresis, recalibration event, or thermal coupling to pendulum rod only).

Real weekly (~7–8 day) environmental cycle decoupled across streams; day-12 shift in pendulum streams is coincidental or represents a separate, second phenomenon overlaid on the cycle.
